entries.20735453b8b20c96: This is a product group of freshly baked cookies, Glass Ochocolat and other items. Sales results for the fiscal year ended January 2026 were ¥804 million.
entries.4a0492f356a6dca4: This business provides food services, such as cakes, coffee and pasta. It operates 28 coffee shops. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended January 2026 was ¥2,073 million.
entries.658874c1ae2cdbbf: This business manufactures and sells dry confectionery, such as chocolates and cookies, fresh Western confectionery, such as cheesecakes and puddings, and other confectionery. Sales are made mainly directly, and the confectionery stores comprise 35 directly operated stores and 141 quasi-directly operated stores. Products are manufactured at the Seishin and Rokko Island plants in Kobe and the Funabashi plant in Funabashi, Chiba, among others; the consolidated subsidiary Kamakura New German Co., Ltd. also runs a Western confectionery manufacturing and sales business, and ＶＩＳＵＡＬ　ＨＯＮＧ　ＫＯＮＧ　ＬＩＭＩＴＥＤ in Hong Kong runs confectionery sales. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended January 2026 was ¥34,199 million.
entries.65ee2559f2286692: This is a product group of chocolate, cookies, desserts and assorted gift sets. Main products include Premium Chocolate Selection, Fayage, Arcadia and Fancy Dessert, among others. Sales results for the fiscal year ended January 2026 were ¥25,111 million.
entries.7c358e269d5a3ada: This is a product group of chilled desserts, cakes and semi-moist confections. Main products include custard pudding, cheesecake, madeleines and financiers, among others. Sales results for the fiscal year ended January 2026 were ¥8,284 million.
entries.d306f7b2ec5a57a5: A company with its head office in Kobe that makes and sells Western confectionery such as chocolate, cookies, cheesecake and pudding, and also operates cafés and restaurants.
